outcome.reasoning: Poisson model: expected goals Chelsea FC 1.49 vs Leeds United FC 0.91, from each side's season scoring and conceding rates at this venue.
evidence: Chelsea FC at home: 3W-1D-1L, 13 scored and 8 conceded in 5 games.
Leeds United FC away: 1W-2D-2L, 3 scored and 5 conceded in 5 games.
League averages this season: home teams 1.53 goals per game, away teams 1.20.
Recent league form (newest first): Chelsea FC LWLWW, Leeds United FC WLDDL (shown for context, not used by the model).
uncertainties: Statistical model only: it ignores injuries, suspensions, lineups, tactics, motivation, fixture congestion and weather.
Small sample: Chelsea FC has 5 home games and Leeds United FC 5 away games this season, so venue-specific rates are noisy (they are blended with overall strength).
Simple Poisson models tend to slightly underestimate draws.
